clean_main.source_pr_title: docs: add selectable time basis to v2.1 plan

v2_1.primary_goal: preserve raw meter time and derive a trustworthy canonical UTC timeline, while giving the Android user a global Local/Meter time-basis preference for presentation and History/Statistics navigation

app_time_basis.local_mode: real/local time primary, raw meter time secondary; navigator uses meter-assigned local timezone -> UTC; Statistics uses coverage/full-containment semantics
app_time_basis.meter_mode: raw meter/logger time primary, resolved local time secondary; navigator and Statistics use raw meter wall-clock semantics

meter_timezone.initial_assignment: Android current ZoneId at first successful verified Live/default read when meter has no assigned timezone

v2_1.home_assistant_contract: future integration always consumes canonical UTC intervals regardless of Android LOCAL/METER preference; raw meter time may be diagnostic metadata only
v2_1.next_action: inventory currently decoded/persisted/portable Type-F raw time, logger time, SU, On-Time, Android acquisition epoch, meter identity and timezone evidence before freezing TimeResolver, DB migration, backup/export or Navigator implementation

private_research.rule: Extend the public product architecture with frozen Research semantics; do not port/merge the Research architecture wholesale.

protected_invariants: normal NFC contact remains protected Live/default read only
History starts only from explicit user action
COMPLETE requires supported traversal completion plus verified final Default Restore/Live
incremental KNOWN_RECORD_REACHED requires secure overlap; timestamp-only overlap is forbidden
accepted archive observations are persisted immediately
ambiguous selected requests are never blindly retried
failed later incremental/full re-sync does not erase an authoritative COMPLETE baseline
never calculate cumulative consumption across meter replacement
QalcosonicReader.java, MbusParser.java and validated NFC/mailbox/archive traversal paths are protected
raw meter/logger time remains preserved source evidence

intentional_remaining_maintenance.ProductUiHardening: active behavior; integrate into owning screens when v2.1 touches History/Settings/About, then remove with regression coverage
intentional_remaining_maintenance.month_compatibility_layer: not wholesale dead code; audit separately before removal
intentional_remaining_maintenance.readme_screenshots: deferred visual documentation task; must not block v2.1 architecture work
